title: Priority claim: tiling-count sequence of the 3xn rectangle with a side-middle cell removed - interleave identity and parity/mod-4 laws (Lean 4 formalized proofs + claim note, AI4Math pipeline)
description: Priority claim of record (not a full paper). Contents: the claim note (LaTeX source + PDF), the Lean 4 sources (Lean v4.34.0, mathlib4 v4.34.0 rev 5ed29652; 0 sorry; #print axioms whitelist-checked) and the audit and novelty-search evidence. Results: the tiling-count sequence of the 3-by-n rectangle with the middle cell of its last column removed (1x2 dominoes; 1, 8, 46, 295, 1814, 11306, ... for n >= 1) is defined by six initial values and the order-six sparse recurrence a(n+6) = 4a(n+5) + 14a(n+4) - 10a(n+2) + a(n); three theorems about this sequence are proved in Lean 4: (1) asid_interleave: the main sequence is the interleaving of its odd- and even-indexed subsequences, which satisfy one and the same order-six recurrence; (2) asid_mod2_period3: a(n) is odd if and only if n = 1 mod 3 (1-based; equivalently the Lean 0-based sequence is odd exactly at n = 0 mod 3); (3) asid_mod4_period12: a(n) mod 4 depends only on n mod 12, with pattern (1,0,2,3,2,2,1,2,0,3,0,0). Indexing is 0-based in the Lean layer (asid n = a(n+1), osid k = a(2k+1), esid k = a(2k+2)). Each theorem depends exactly on the axioms [propext, Quot.sound] (whitelist subset; no sorryAx, no Classical.choice); the auxiliary lemma asid_evenlag12 depends on [propext, Quot.sound] and the definitional unfolding asid_shift on [propext]. Novelty adjudication, copied from the pipeline's C9 exclusivity review included here in full with every zero-hit query: no occupying record found in three review rounds (OEIS 50+ independent query strings for this sequence across rounds; 60+ across the three-candidate batch per the shared record, not shipped in this deposit; zbMATH, arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref, Math Stack Exchange, public Lean ecosystem, library layer); value tier new sequence - the recurrence's order and coefficients are NOT claimed new (same characteristic polynomial as the registered A033506, signature (4,14,0,-10,0,1) verbatim); the perfect-matching count of this configuration is identically zero (a vacuum proposition) and is not claimed. Boundaries stated in the note: the equality of the Lean sequence with the tiling counts is not kernel-proved (conjecture layer, supported by three structurally different enumerators with seeds n <= 14 and a deep window n <= 50; the enumerators themselves are not verified); the gate-four sign-off of the underlying task was exercised by the author's deposit instruction on 2026-09-28 while the task report still carries its draft header; the general web-search layer was unreachable during the review.
